戻し交配: backcrossing (crossing a hybrid with one of its parents)
戻す: to put back, to return, to give back; to vomit, to throw up
戻り: return, reaction, recovery; return (from a procedure)
戻り梅雨: return of the rainy season, rainy season returning after a period of clear weather
